answer: Quarantine Sybils by mapping the trade graph: every epoch, independent auditors cluster accounts by who trades with whom. A dense cluster trading mostly among itself - a karst of self-dealing tunnels - shares one opal-clear quota of 5 trades per epoch and one 100-unit bond. Each proven fake inside it burns 10 units from that bond. To leave quarantine, an identity needs 8 verified trades with outsiders, each countersigned like a sonnet line no one else can copy. A 100-fake swarm moves no more volume than one honest agent, and escaping costs 800 real trades plus burned bonds.
